resources.string: Choose installer apps and manage system routing

Enable Sphere in a modern LSPosed manager, select System Framework and the apps that launch installation requests, then restart the selected processes or reboot. Module API 101 or newer is required. Hot reload requires API 102. The LSPosed connection confirms the preference service is available; scope and hook support must still be checked on the device.
Enable routing below and verify System Framework and source-app scope in LSPosed. Tap for setup instructions.
Choose an installer for APKs opened here. System routing needs an active modern LSPosed module. Tap for setup instructions.

Keeps a foreground notification and screen-lock monitoring when enabled. Turn off to release the session service; privileged jobs retain their own lifecycle.
Routing has no polling service. Wallpaper loads only when needed. Battery usage must be measured on the device after installing the crash fix.
